description: Hostile-peer case: a relay-info response whose supported-versions array omits the required protocol version 1 (Section 12.2: a v1 implementation MUST include protocol version 1). The content requirement is part of the applicable v1 schema (Appendix A closing note), so the receiving client MUST reject the complete response (Section 12.1) with the schemaViolation classification (Sections 15.3, 6.1.3) and extract no usable protocol state from it. Every other member is valid example content, so the assertion is fault-isolated.
scenario: A hostile or non-conforming peer serves an otherwise well-formed info response advertising only an unknown protocol version.
structuralRequirements: label 3 omits protocol version 1; label 4 still carries suite -19, isolating the fault
the client MUST reject the complete response and MUST NOT extract a relay identifier, limits, generations, or any other protocol state from it
the local classification is schemaViolation (Section 15.3 code 6, Section 6.1.3 fallback)
